definitions.intervention_match: Studies are matched with ClinicalTrials.gov's intervention search, which includes brand names and development codes (e.g. 'Keytruda', 'MK-3475').
definitions.unit: Each bar/point/edge counts distinct studies (NCT IDs), never sites or arms.
definitions.start_year: Year of the registered study start date (actual, or anticipated if not yet started). This is not the same as being active during that year.

assumptions: 'Over time' = count of pembrolizumab trials by registered study start year.
All study types, phases, statuses and countries are included.
Request field drug_name='Pembrolizumab' applied to every cohort.
Studies without a registered start date are excluded from the trend.
warnings: 5 studies have anticipated start dates after 2026.
2026 is still in progress; its count is partial.
